patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.
patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Known diabetes mellitus for 35 years and hypertension for 20 years. History of acute myocardial infarction.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Smokes 15–20 cigarettes per day for the past 40 years.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies fever, vomiting. Reports bloody loose bowel movements.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with sudden onset of abdominal pain, focusing on the relevance of the patient's medical history and current symptoms.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I’m a 74-year-old man, and about 16 hours ago I developed sudden, severe abdominal pain around my umbilicus. Since then I’ve had several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements, but I haven’t had vomiting. I was hospitalized for a heart attack a week ago.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations) recently?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any scratched, rubbed-raw, or open spots on my skin recently. I’ve mainly been dealing with the sudden severe belly pain and multiple episodes of bloody loose stools.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you suddenly wake up gasping for air during sleep? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any episodes where I stop breathing or suddenly wake up gasping during sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury or fall, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—after any minor injury or fall I haven’t noticed severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using an injured area; my main issue is the sudden severe abdominal pain and the bloody loose bowel movements.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared with the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist or any significant skin changes compared with the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the skin of your chest), especially after an injury or from coughing/strain?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall—no dark or discolored areas on my chest from any injury, coughing, or straining.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine than normal?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed urinating much more than usual or any clear increase in frequency or amount. My main symptoms have been the sudden severe abdominal pain and the bloody loose bowel movements.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, yes—I currently smoke about 15–20 cigarettes per day. I don’t use alcohol, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs as far as I know.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine, leaking, or accidents; I’ve been making it to the bathroom as usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere on your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin spots, sores, or growths anywhere on my body. My main concerns are the sudden severe abdominal pain and the episodes of bloody loose bowel movements.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount), or blood coming from your nose?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t had any nosebleeds or blood coming from my nose recently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk—no redness or spots on my chest, back, or belly. My main symptoms are the sudden severe abdominal pain and multiple episodes of bloody loose stools.”
